cut: Global 1, VIRAL CUT v1 (23 Oct) of Approved Vendor — owner, 23 Oct: 'Test other 2 as well and rest after' (the viral format, plan/films/20b-approved-vendor-viral.md). The hook is frame 0; the last frame hands back to it. Captions rewritten for clarity before the first build (coordinator, 23 Oct: every caption must stand on its own for a cold viewer).
argument: Researchers say an ad firm's ads delivered spyware with no click, targeting at least 45 devices at one newsroom; the firm sat on the ad industry's approved list for six years, suspended only in October.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.ja: 広告会社の 広告が / [スパイウェア] を 配信。

captions.source: Citizen Lab, 'Exposing AdFection', 15 Oct 2026: Discover-Tech's targeted ads delivered Candiru spyware; the ad's code checked the device's ad ID and IP and, for a target, returned code that could load a browser exploit. Reuters, TechCrunch, The Record, CyberScoop, BleepingComputer (v1 re-check, 22 Oct); re-checked 23 Oct (Dark Reading, PPC Land, The National, The Print; search summaries): nothing newer moves it. The firm is not named; 'an ad firm's ads', never ads in general. The researchers are on the tag from frame 0 (CITIZEN LAB · 15.10.2026).

text.en: [No click] needed: / just seeing the ad / was enough.
text.ja: [クリック] 不要。 / 広告を 見る だけで / 十分 だった。

captions.source: Citizen Lab (15 Oct): the delivery needed no click; the ad being shown was enough. Corroborated by Reuters, TechCrunch, The Record (v1 table, plan/films/20-approved-vendor.md); unchanged on 23 Oct.

text.en: At least 45 / devices at one / newsroom were / [targeted].
text.ja: ある 報道機関で / 少なくとも 45台が / [標的] に された。

captions.source: Citizen Lab (15 Oct): at least 45 devices at one newsroom targeted in 2024 and 2025, spyware attributed 'with high confidence' to Candiru; it does not know which government was the customer. 'Targeted', not 'infected'. The newsroom is not named (v1 table; unchanged on 23 Oct).

text.en: For six years / the firm sat on / the ad industry's / [approved list].
text.fi: Kuusi vuotta / yhtiö oli mainosalan / [hyväksytyllä listalla].
text.ja: その会社は 6年間、 / 広告業界の / [承認済み リスト] に 載っていた。

captions.source: IAB Europe's Transparency & Consent Framework Global Vendor List: Discover-Tech registered as vendor 778 from 2 July 2020 (ppc.land, from the GVL archive) until its suspension in early October 2026 (8 Oct per Citizen Lab; 'last week' per IAB Europe to Reuters, 15 Oct). Six years and three months, said as six years. 'Approved list': Reuters' wording for IAB Europe's list of globally approved vendors; Citizen Lab reports IAB Europe says it vets and approves applications (v1 table).

text.ja: 承認済み ベンダー。 / 資格停止は / [10月] に なってから。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: a rubber stamp comes down on the firm's row of the list, SUSPENDED · OCT 2026. 'Approved vendor' is not a quote: Reuters' wording for IAB Europe's list. Suspended in early October 2026 (8 Oct per Citizen Lab), after an audit found TCF Policy violations (IAB Europe, 15 Oct); 'only' because it had been listed since July 2020. The suspension can be lifted or become an expulsion. It clears 0.45 s before the end so the last frame is the banner again (the loop).

list.ja: IAB EUROPE · グローバル・ベンダーリスト

banner.why: the banner ad's words, under its paper sun: an ordinary-looking ad, the same in every master; it stands in for the firm's ads and carries no brand

newsroom.en: 45 laptops, each with the same banner
newsroom.why: the escalation as a count: one laptop for each targeted device; laptops, not phones (v1's rule); no newsroom is named

clipboard.en: GLOBAL VENDOR LIST / PURPOSES · LEGAL BASIS · CONSENT · 2020–2026
clipboard.why: the list's own name, the kinds of thing a vendor declares, and one sheet a year, in English in every master; no vendor is named

stamp.why: the punchline as a thing: no logo and no company's name

post.en: An ad firm's ads delivered spyware. No click needed: seeing the ad was enough. At least 45 devices at one newsroom were targeted (Citizen Lab, 15 Oct). The firm sat on the ad industry's approved list for six years, suspended only in October. Would you have spotted it?
post.fi: Mainosyhtiön mainokset levittivät vakoiluohjelmaa. Ei klikkausta: mainoksen näkeminen riitti. Ainakin 45 laitetta yhdessä toimituksessa oli kohteena (Citizen Lab, 15.10.). Yhtiö oli mainosalan hyväksytyllä listalla kuusi vuotta, jäädytettiin vasta lokakuussa. Huomaisitko?
post.ja: 広告会社の広告がスパイウェアを配信した。クリック不要、広告を見るだけで十分だった。ある報道機関で少なくとも45台の端末が標的に（シチズンラボ、10月15日）。その会社は6年間、広告業界の承認済みリストに載り、資格停止は10月になってから。あなたなら気づいた？
